module: Flowgraph node "Rally Position Getter" (category repeat_instant, tag rally). Looks in a pathData for the start position with the given name (pathData:findStartPositionByName) and returns its position (pos) and rotation (rot). The flow output is true when the position is found.
notes: Despite the description ("from the current rally loop manager"), the node does not use the loop manager: only pathData matters.
pos and rot are returned as is (vec3 and quat of the path, not tables).

_executionStarted.desc: Sets the flow output to false at start.

work.desc: Looks for the named position and fills pos, rot and flow.
